means.example-sentence: I had to kill a couple of hours the other day, so I hung around in a park nearby.
means.sentence-jp: 先日、私は2、3時間つぶさなければならなかったので、近くの公園をぶらついた。

cloze.maskedText: I had to kill a couple of hours the other day, so I ____ in a park nearby.
cloze.answerBase: hang around / hang about / hang round

notes: 「〜と付き合う[時間を過ごす]」は、hang around [about / round] with ~。
